_comment: Solstice M0 card data - fire branch. Contract: shared/schema/card.schema.json. Names come from docs/CARDS.md SS3.1 (M0 first ten candidates) plus provisional M0 grid slots.
_note: provisional=true means: this slot is written for playability so the M0 grid is complete, while its effect / params / animation / visible feedback have NOT yet been authored per card (CARD-LIST SS3 definition). Authoring order follows P1-P4 need.

desc.zh: 一粒火星落在纸上，亮一下就没了。零环碎片，暗夜里最好看。
desc.en: One spark lands on the paper, glows, and is gone. A tier-0 shard, at its best in the dark.

desc.zh: 手心按在纸面上，那一小块就暖了。
desc.en: Press a palm to the paper and that small patch warms.

desc.zh: 这一小片会一直比周围暖一点，像刚被人离开。
desc.en: This little patch stays a little warmer than its surroundings, as if someone just left.

desc.zh: 一具小小的火盆。只要下面还有东西可烧，它就不灭。
desc.en: A small brazier. It keeps burning as long as there is something beneath it to burn.

desc.zh: 落点要有可燃物才点得着；纸是烧得起来的。
desc.en: It only catches if the landing spot has something to burn, and paper burns.

desc.zh: 这一片从此不容易留住水，火走过的地方会更容易再着。
desc.en: This ground no longer holds water well, and where fire has passed it catches more easily.

desc.zh: 一堆火。它是这一片夜里唯一的亮点，也是最早把纸烧黑的东西。
desc.en: A pile of fire: the only bright thing at night, and the first thing that blackens the paper.

desc.zh: 区域内气温上升八度；可以用降温把它改回去。
desc.en: Air temperature in the area rises by eight degrees; a chill card can put it back.

desc.zh: 这一片的天更愿意起云、更快落雨，火跑得也更快。
desc.en: The sky over this ground clouds sooner and rains sooner; fire runs faster too.

desc.zh: 地面裂开一处，底下是烧红的纸浆。它自己会一直热下去。
desc.en: The ground opens; beneath it the paper pulp is glowing. It will keep itself hot.

desc.zh: 一片原野同时点着。烧过的纸会留下灰，灰会变成地力。
desc.en: A whole plain catches at once. Burnt paper leaves ash, and ash becomes fertility.

desc.zh: 整个界从此记着：烧掉的东西要还回来。火过之处铺一层灰。
desc.en: The realm now remembers: what burns must come back. A layer of ash is spread where fire has passed.
